versions.content: In case received SDU Type does neither equals a content based CAN XL frame (SDU Type 01h) or a tunneled CAN 2.0/FD frame (Sdu Type 112 of 224 Document ID 12: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANInterface Specification of CAN Interface AUTOSAR CP R22-11 03h), it shall not be further processed within CanIf . In case the matching CanIfRxP- duCfg has configured CanIfRxPduCfg->CanIfRxPduUserRxIndicationUL equals CDD, it shall be passed further containing MetaData to the configured <User_RxIndica- tion>() .
